_readme: Copy this to ~/.claude/token-dashboard-subprojects.json (or point TOKEN_DASHBOARD_SUBPROJECTS at your own copy) and edit the groups below. Each 'patterns' entry is a Python regex tested against every Bash/Read/Edit/Write tool-call target in a session (case-insensitive). Anchor a leading [\\/] before the folder name so you don't match prose that mentions the project by name in an unrelated command. Do NOT require a trailing [\\/] too -- a lot of real signal is `cd "/path/to/project" && ...`, where nothing follows the folder name but a quote or `&&`, not another path segment. Use a trailing lookahead like (?=[\\/\s"'&;)]|$) instead so both 'continues as a path' and 'command ends here' count as a match. A session's cost is split across whichever groups its calls match, weighted by each group's share of that session's real tool calls; anything left over stays on the session's own Claude Code project slug.
